s_boards.title: Boards
s_boards.description: Every ESPHome board of this integration. The encryption key is the one in the board YAML under api: encryption: key:. Leave it empty for an unencrypted board.

id.label: Board id
id.description: Leave empty: it is generated when the board is saved.

importKeys.label: Import encryption keys
importKeys.description: Read each board's key from the ESPHome Builder add-on in Home Assistant, using the Home Assistant token already configured. Needs an administrator token. Boards that cannot be read are listed with the reason.
